fact: The education ministry's Information and Documentation Centre reports that on Wednesday 29 March 2023 it held, in cooperation with UNICEF Libya, the first workshop on the OpenEMIS system, at which the centre's director general described its uses for the student, the teacher, the school administration and the ministry's supervisory offices, and UNICEF's international consultant set out what must be in place to localise the system in Libya; the text describes preparation only, names no school using it and does not say what records it will hold.
title: ورشة عمل حول نظام “OPEN EMIS”
publisher: مركز المعلومات والتوثيق، وزارة التربية والتعليم
